keyPoints.hi: Metaphor: like/as के बिना सीधी तुलना
Personification: चीज़ें इंसानों जैसा काम करती हैं

problem.en: Name the figure of speech: "Her smile was as bright as the sun."
problem.hi: अलंकार बताओ: "Her smile was as bright as the sun."

steps.hi: यह "as … as" से तुलना करता है।

problem.en: Name the figure of speech: "The trees danced in the storm."
problem.hi: अलंकार बताओ: "The trees danced in the storm."

steps.en: Trees cannot really dance; they are given a human action.
steps.hi: पेड़ सच में नहीं नाचते; उन्हें इंसानी काम दिया गया।

question.en: Complete the simile: "as busy as a __"
question.hi: simile पूरी करो: "as busy as a __"

intro.en: Poets use figures of speech. A simile compares using "like" or "as" (as brave as a lion). A metaphor says one thing is another (Time is money). Personification gives human qualities to things (The wind whispered).
intro.hi: कवि अलंकारों का प्रयोग करते हैं। Simile "like" या "as" से तुलना करता है (as brave as a lion)। Metaphor कहता है कि एक चीज़ दूसरी है (Time is money)। Personification चीज़ों को इंसानी गुण देता है (The wind whispered)।
